label: Contribution per unit
meaning: What one unit leaves us after every variable cost of getting it sold — the money that pays fixed costs and profit.
formula_text: C = P_net − L − W − D − M − K

label: Contribution per order
meaning: Contribution earned on one typical order to this channel.

label: Contribution per month
meaning: Contribution this play earns in a month at the realistic volume.

label: Net price (P_net)
meaning: What we actually receive per unit after the channel takes its margin, rebate and listing fees.
formula_text: P_net = list × (1 − channel margin − rebate) − listing fee total ÷ expected units over listing period

label: List price
meaning: The price our direct customer resells at, before sales tax.
formula_text: Shelf ÷ (1 + t), less the retailer margin when a distributor sits in between

label: Landed cost (L)
meaning: Cost of one unit sitting cleared in our warehouse in the market: product, freight, insurance, duty, clearance and any tax we cannot recover.
formula_text: L = CIF + duty + clearance + import tax (if not recoverable)

label: CIF
meaning: Cost, insurance and freight: product price plus getting it to the destination port.
formula_text: CIF = supplier price + origin handling + freight + insurance

label: Import duty
meaning: Customs duty charged on CIF value, at the rate for this HS code, origin and trade regime.

label: Import tax
meaning: GST / SST / VAT charged at import. A cost only when we cannot claim it back.
formula_text: import tax = (CIF + duty) × import tax rate

label: Warehousing per unit (W)
meaning: Storage and handling cost carried by one unit while it waits to be sold.
formula_text: W = pallet cost/day × stock days ÷ units per pallet + handling per order ÷ units per order

label: Delivery per unit (D)
meaning: Cost of delivering one unit to the channel's door or DC.
formula_text: D = delivery cost per drop ÷ units per drop

label: Marketing per unit (M)
meaning: Promotion, sampling and merchandising spend spread over each unit sold.

label: Cash cost per unit (K)
meaning: Financing cost of the cash tied up in stock and unpaid invoices for this unit.
formula_text: K = L × annual finance rate × (stock days + receivable days − payable days) ÷ 365

label: Break-even volume
meaning: Units per month needed before this channel's fixed costs are covered.

label: Value density (V)
meaning: Net revenue per cubic metre shipped. Low values mean freight and space will eat the margin.

label: Max affordable landed cost (L_max)
meaning: The highest landed cost we can carry and still break even at the target shelf price.
formula_text: L_max = P_shelf ÷ (1 + t) × (1 − m_retail) × (1 − m_dist) − S

label: Headroom
meaning: How far our landed cost sits below the maximum the shelf price allows. Negative means the price does not work.

label: Cost to serve + marketing (S)
meaning: Everything after landing that it costs to serve the channel per unit: warehousing, delivery, financing, trade spend and marketing.
formula_text: S = W + D + K + trade spend + M

label: Trade spend per unit
meaning: Rebates and listing fees per unit paid to the channel.
formula_text: rebate × list + listing fee total ÷ listing period units

label: Market attractiveness
meaning: 0–100 score of how attractive the market is, from size, access, competition, right to win and growth.
formula_text: Σ weight × factor score ÷ Σ weights

label: Return on cash (R)
meaning: First-year contribution after entry costs, divided by the most cash the play ties up. Ranks plays.
formula_text: R = (C × Q_realistic × 12 − E) ÷ peak cash tied up

label: Peak cash tied up
meaning: Most cash locked in stock and receivables, net of what suppliers let us owe.

label: Year-1 contribution after entry cost
meaning: Twelve months of contribution less one-off entry cost.

label: Distributor margin
meaning: Share of the distributor's selling price it keeps.

label: Retailer / channel margin
meaning: Share of the channel's selling price (ex-tax) it keeps.

label: Channel margin
meaning: Margin taken by our direct customer on its selling price.
formula_text: distributor margin if a distributor buys from us, else retailer margin

label: Listing fee
meaning: One-off fee a chain charges to put a SKU on shelf.

label: Credit days
meaning: Days the customer takes to pay us after delivery.

label: Stock days
meaning: Average days a unit sits in our warehouse before it ships.

label: Supplier price
meaning: What we pay the principal per unit at the factory gate (EXW) or FOB.

label: Origin handling
meaning: Trucking and handling from factory to the departure port, per unit.

label: Main freight
meaning: Sea, road or air freight from origin to the destination, per unit.

label: Insurance
meaning: Cargo insurance per unit.

label: Duty rate
meaning: Customs duty rate for this HS code, origin and regime.
formula_text: trade rule lookup (MFN if no certificate of origin)

label: Import tax rate
meaning: GST / SST / VAT charged when goods are imported.

label: Import tax recoverable
meaning: Whether we can claim the import tax back (e.g. GST-registered importer in Singapore).

label: Clearance
meaning: Customs broker, permit and port charges per unit.

label: Shelf price
meaning: Price the end buyer pays, including sales tax.

label: Sales tax on shelf (t)
meaning: VAT / GST / SST included in the shelf price.

label: Rebate
meaning: Rebate paid back to the channel as a share of list price.

label: Listing fees (total)
meaning: All listing fees paid for this SKU in this channel.

label: Units over listing period
meaning: Units we expect to sell over the period the listing fee covers.

label: Pallet cost per day
meaning: Warehouse or 3PL storage charge per pallet per day.

label: Units per pallet
meaning: Selling units on one pallet.
formula_text: cartons per pallet × units per carton

label: Handling per order
meaning: Pick-and-pack charge per outbound order.

label: Units per order
meaning: Typical units in one order from this channel.

label: Delivery cost per drop
meaning: Cost of one delivery to the channel's store or DC.

label: Units per drop
meaning: Units delivered in one drop.

label: Annual finance rate
meaning: Yearly cost of the money tied up in stock and receivables.

label: Receivable days
meaning: Days until the channel pays us.

label: Payable days
meaning: Days until we must pay the principal.

label: Fixed monthly cost (F)
meaning: Monthly cost of serving this channel regardless of volume: salesperson, van, listing upkeep.

label: Volume per unit
meaning: Shipping volume of one unit, from carton dimensions.
formula_text: carton L × W × H ÷ units per carton

label: Realistic volume
meaning: Units per month we realistically expect to sell in this play.

label: Entry cost (E)
meaning: One-off cost to start: certification, listing, launch.

label: Exchange rate
meaning: Rate used to convert between currencies.

label: Price per litre / kg
meaning: Shelf price normalised to one litre (or kilogram) so different pack sizes compare.
formula_text: price ÷ pack size in L or kg

label: Trade-services fee income
meaning: Fees the principal pays us under the contract's fee model.
